questions.stem: 這幾年來，不會說外語的旅客一直靠機器翻譯和當地人溝通。
questions.answer: In recent years, travelers who can't speak foreign languages have been relying on machine translation to communicate with locals.
accepted_answers: Over the past few years, travelers who don't speak any foreign languages have been depending on machine translation to talk with local people.
For the last few years, travelers who are unable to speak foreign languages have been using machine translation to communicate with local people.

questions.stem: 在沒有人會說英語的小鎮上，這些翻譯工具已經幫了他們很大的忙。
questions.answer: In small towns where no one speaks English, these translation tools have helped them a lot.
accepted_answers: In small towns where nobody can speak English, these translation tools have helped them a great deal.
In small towns in which no one speaks English, these translation tools have helped them very much.

1.explanation_zh: 「這幾年來一直…」表示從過去持續到現在、而且仍在進行，用現在完成進行式 have been relying on（或 have been depending on）。「不會說外語的旅客」中文把修飾語放在前面，英文要改成 travelers who can't speak foreign languages（關係代名詞 who 指人）。「機器翻譯」是名詞 machine translation；「和當地人溝通」是依靠翻譯的目的，用不定詞 to communicate with locals／local people。
1.strategy_zh: 「這幾年來一直…」先想現在完成（進行）式；「…的＋人」修飾語很長時，改成「名詞＋who 子句」。
hints: 切成四段：這幾年來／不會說外語的旅客／一直靠機器翻譯／和當地人溝通
標的詞彙：traveler（旅客）、foreign（外國的）、rely（依賴；rely on）、translation（翻譯）、communicate（溝通）、local（當地人）
句型框架：In recent years, N + who + V … + have been + V-ing …

2.explanation_zh: 「沒有人會說英語的小鎮」是表示地點的名詞加上修飾語，英文把修飾語放到後面，用關係副詞 where（＝in which）：small towns where no one speaks English；子句本身已經完整，不能用 which。no one／nobody 是單數，動詞用 speaks。「已經幫了很大的忙」的影響延續到現在，用現在完成式 have helped them a lot（或 a great deal）。「這些翻譯工具」回指上一句的機器翻譯。
evidence: 在沒有人會說英語的小鎮上
已經幫了他們很大的忙
2.strategy_zh: 先判斷修飾地點的子句缺不缺主詞或受詞：子句完整就用 where，缺受詞才用 which／that；「已經」想現在完成式。
hints: 切成四段：在沒有人會說英語的小鎮上／這些翻譯工具／已經幫了他們／很大的忙
標的詞彙：town（小鎮）、speak（說）、translation（翻譯）、tool（工具）、help（幫助）、great（很大的；a lot／a great deal）
句型框架：In + 地點 N + where + S + V …, S + have + p.p. …

references: In recent years, travelers who can't speak foreign languages have been relying on machine translation to communicate with locals.
Over the past few years, travelers who don't speak any foreign languages have been depending on machine translation to talk with local people.
For the last few years, travelers who are unable to speak foreign languages have been using machine translation to communicate with local people.

traps.explanation_zh: 「不會說外語的旅客」修飾語很長，英文要放到名詞後面，改成關係子句 travelers who can't speak foreign languages。

traps.explanation_zh: 「機器翻譯」在這裡是名詞，用 machine translation；translate 是動詞。

common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞 these translation tools 是複數，用 have。

traps.zh: 沒有人會說英語的小鎮
traps.literal_error: In no one speaks English small towns, these translation tools have helped them a lot.
traps.explanation_zh: 「沒有人會說英語的小鎮」照中文語序把子句放在名詞前面不通；英文改成 small towns where no one speaks English。

traps.literal_error: In small towns where no one speaks English, these translation tools already helped them a lot.
traps.explanation_zh: 「已經」的影響延續到現在，用現在完成式 have helped；只寫 already helped 會扣分。

2.restructuring_zh: 「沒有人會說英語的小鎮」改成名詞＋關係副詞子句 small towns where no one speaks English（「…的＋名詞」改後位修飾）。

1.translation: For the past few years, travelers who cannot speak foreign languages have been relying on machine translation to communicate with local people.
1.explanation_zh: 「這幾年來…一直」用 For the past few years 加現在完成進行式；「不會說外語的旅客」用 who 關係子句；「靠…和當地人溝通」用 rely on N to V。

2.translation: In small towns where no one speaks English, these translation tools have been a great help to them.
2.explanation_zh: 「在沒有人會說英語的小鎮上」用關係副詞 where 修飾 small towns；「已經幫了很大的忙」用現在完成式 have been a great help to them（也可寫 have helped them a lot）。

1.translation: For the past few years, travelers who cannot speak foreign languages have been relying on machine translation to communicate with locals.
1.explanation_zh: 「這幾年來……一直」用 for the past few years 搭配現在完成進行式 have been relying on；「靠……和當地人溝通」用 rely on ... to communicate with locals。

2.translation: In small towns where no one speaks English, these translation tools have already helped them a great deal.
2.explanation_zh: 「在沒有人會說英語的小鎮上」用 where 關係子句修飾 small towns；「已經幫了……很大的忙」用現在完成式 have already helped them a great deal。
